items.title: MECH-471 local-update interference test (EXP-0399): does a targeted REINFORCE update on one competence degrade an unrelated, previously-acquired competence?
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1: no prior manifest carries this readout (cross-competence interference under a targeted REINFORCE update) on any compatible substrate_hash -- zero-evidence claim, nothing to reanalyze; proceeding to run. complicated (buildable) per the proposal's own note -- tests only whether the interference phenomenon exists on existing substrate, does not build/exercise any provenance/rollback machinery. Uses survival/avoidance competence (two reef-placement geometries, same obs dims) rather than foraging, deliberately, to avoid the MECH-457 foraging-competence ceiling documented across 719a/724/728/734/742/780/788. strength_0 arm minted reuse-eligible (mint-as-you-go).

items.title: Q-004 tau_R calibration at larger training budget, selection-instrument fixed (supersedes V3-EXQ-149)
items.note: Q-004 replication at a larger training budget, per claims.yaml what_would_answer. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout not recoverable from any existing manifest -- EXQ-149 is the only prior run and cannot answer this (see defect below). Re-derive brake (2.5b): 0 failure_autopsy artifacts exist for Q-004/EXQ-149. CRITICAL FINDING during Step 3.5 code review: EXQ-149's action selection was unconditionally random.randint(...) in both training and eval, in every condition -- agent.e3.harm_eval() was trained but never consulted for selection, and residue_field.evaluate_trajectory() was never called. mean_harm under an RNG-only policy cannot depend on tau_R at ANY budget -- EXQ-149's identical-mean_harm finding is close to an arithmetic identity (DV-symmetry defect), not evidence of behavioural inertness. FIX (instrument repair, same claim/conditions/thresholds): action selection now routes through agent.hippocampal.propose_trajectories + agent.select_action (adapted from the already-reviewed V3-EXQ-120a pattern), giving tau_R two real causal channels into behavior (CEM candidate scoring vs residue terrain; E3 compute_residue_cost). Budget: WARMUP_EPISODES 300->600 (2x), EVAL_EPISODES 100->150 (1.5x) -- sized against a REAL timed calibration (10 warmup + 5 eval eps measured 32.2 sec/episode). New non-gating readiness diagnostics (R1 candidate_action_diversity>=1.5, R2 hippo_fallback_rate<0.5) guard against the fix silently degrading back to random selection. Smoke (--dry-run): all 6 cells complete, hippo_fallback_rate=0.0 everywhere, candidate_diversity_min 2.0-3.0, validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings. Estimated ~40 hr total across 6 cells; machine_affinity=any per project convention.

items.title: MECH-472 held-out context vs task memorisation, training-exposure sweep (EXP-0400)
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1: zero prior evidence for MECH-472 (claim_evidence.v1.json has no entry) and no manifest anywhere carries a held-out-vs-in-context survival gap readout on this env family -- not recoverable, proceeding to run. Substrate readiness: CausalGridWorldV2's per-instance seeded RNG (causal_grid_world.py ~:1235, draws advance across reset() without re-seeding) already generates a distinct hazard/resource surface configuration per seed under fixed task structure -- confirmed sufficient context-set machinery, no new build required. Does NOT depend on V3-EXQ-875/EXP-0399 completing: reuses its 'corner' reef-geometry env kwargs verbatim but trains ONE competence (not the interference pair), so the proposal's conditional baseline-fingerprint-reuse note ('if the competence set matches') is confirmed NOT applicable here -- this experiment mints its own arms from scratch. complicated (buildable) per its own design.
